verdict.rationale: Cubic's docs describe a "Fix with cubic" button on review findings that generates the fix and pushes it to the PR branch. Users can also request fixes by tagging or replying to @cubic-dev-ai in PR comments, and an auto-fix mode applies fixes from every review using a configured coding-agent provider, all inside the PR. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the in-PR fixes work as documented.
